title: Test a change
advice: Write down the user-visible result. Run the smallest existing check that can fail for the reported behavior. Compare the result before and after the change.

title: Recover an interrupted job
advice: Find the last durable checkpoint. Separate completed work from pending work. Confirm the next operation is safe to repeat before resuming it.

title: Review a release
advice: List the artifacts and intended audience. Verify a clean install and the rollback path. Get the owner's approval before publishing anything.

title: Inspect a failed run
advice: Select one failed run and its time window. Compare the first failing stage against a successful run. Report the observed difference without copying private log contents.
